description: The TN-36 RTO serves the Gobichettipalayam region within the Erode district of Tamil Nadu. It manages vehicle registrations, driving license renewals, and transport permits for a significant portion of the western agricultural belt of the state.
address: 6A, Budhar Street, Erode Sathy Main Road, Pudupalayam, Gobichettipalayam, Erode, Tamil Nadu
